slides.sub: Your long run starts before sunrise. Swipe.

slides.title: LIGHT YOURSELF UP
slides.head: Wear something bright or reflective.
slides.body: Drivers see your kit before they see you. A small flashing light helps.

slides.title: BRING A LIGHT
slides.head: A headlamp or torch beats your phone screen.
slides.body: Potholes and kerbs don't show up in the dark.

slides.title: KEEP IT FAMILIAR
slides.head: Run routes you know, with street lights.
slides.body: Save the new trail for daylight.

slides.title: SHARE YOUR ROUTE
slides.head: Let someone know where you're going.
slides.body: And roughly when you'll be back.

slides.title: ONE EARBUD MAX
slides.head: Keep at least one ear on the road.
slides.body: Or leave the music at home and enjoy the quiet.

slides.title: FACE THE CARS
slides.head: No pavement? Run facing oncoming traffic.
slides.body: You see them coming, and they see you.

slides.sub: For every dark, early start this summer.
